mapper.select: SELECT a.fbx03_file_id AS file_id , a.fbx03_box_id AS box_id , a.fbx03_dcr_class_id AS dcr_class_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(a.fbx03_dcr_class_id) AS dcr_class_name , a.fbx03_emp_id AS emp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(a.fbx03_emp_id) AS emp_name , a.fbx03_crt_date AS crt_date , c.sys10_file_nm AS file_name FROM fbx01_box b INNER JOIN fbx03_file a ON b.fbx01_box_id = a.fbx03_box_id INNER JOIN sys10_file c ON a.fbx03_file_id = c.sys10_parent_id INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree d ON a.fbx03_dcr_class_id = d.dcr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth e ON (a.fbx03_dcr_class_id = e.dcr03_class_tree_id AND e.dcr03_org_code_id = #{orgId}) LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr04_emp_auth f ON (a.fbx03_dcr_class_id = f.dcr04_class_tree_id AND f.dcr04_person_id = #{empId}) WHERE 1=1 AND ( COALESCE(dcr04_retrieve_yn, dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') = 'true' OR fbx03_emp_id = #{empId} ) AND fbx01_company_id = #{companyId} AND fbx03_box_id = #{boxId} AND fbx03_dcr_class_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree(dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_company_id, dcr01_parent_tree_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_company_id, dcr01_parent_tree_id, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a2.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a2.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a2.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a2.dcr01_class_tree_id], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a2 WHERE dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND dcr01_class_tree_id = #{dcrClassId} AND dcr01_use_yn = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT a2.dcr01_class_tree_id, a2.dcr01_company_id, a2.dcr01_parent_tree_id, b2.depth + 1, array_append(b2.path, CAST(a2.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a2.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a2.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a2.dcr01_class_tree_id), a2.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b2.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a2 INNER JOIN dcr_tree b2 ON b2.dcr01_class_tree_id = a2.dcr01_parent_tree_id WHERE a2.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a2.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND NOT cycle ) SELECT dcr01_class_tree_id FROM dcr_tree )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.fbx03_file_id AS file_id , a.fbx03_box_id AS box_id , a.fbx03_dcr_class_id AS dcr_class_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(a.fbx03_dcr_class_id) AS dcr_class_name , a.fbx03_emp_id AS emp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(a.fbx03_emp_id) AS emp_name , a.fbx03_crt_date AS crt_date , c.sys10_file_nm AS file_name FROM fbx01_box b INNER JOIN fbx03_file a ON b.fbx01_box_id = a.fbx03_box_id INNER JOIN sys10_file c ON a.fbx03_file_id = c.sys10_parent_id INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree d ON a.fbx03_dcr_class_id = d.dcr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth e ON (a.fbx03_dcr_class_id = e.dcr03_class_tree_id AND e.dcr03_org_code_id = #{orgId}) LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr04_emp_auth f ON (a.fbx03_dcr_class_id = f.dcr04_class_tree_id AND f.dcr04_person_id = #{empId}) WHERE 1=1 AND fbx03_box_id = #{boxId} AND fbx01_company_id = #{companyId} AND fbx03_emp_id IN ( SELECT emp01_person_id FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp01_kor_nm LIKE #{regEmpName} ) AND ( COALESCE(dcr04_retrieve_yn, dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') = 'true' OR fbx03_emp_id = #{empId} ) ) a WHERE UPPER(dcr_class_name || file_name) LIKE UPPER(#{fileName})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbx03_file (fbx03_file_id, fbx03_box_id, fbx03_dcr_class_id, fbx03_org_code_id, fbx03_emp_id, fbx03_status_cd, fbx03_crt_date, fbx03_note) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{boxId}, #{dcrClassId}, #{orgCodeId}, #{empId}, '00', f_sysdate(), '')
